title: Sefaria
description: Searchable Jewish texts, translations and linked commentaries. Check the version and translator before citing.
access: Free library; some features require an account

title: AlHaTorah
description: Texts, commentaries and edition-specific research tools. Use the individual edition’s introduction to establish its textual basis.

title: Hebrew Wikisource
description: Collaboratively transcribed Hebrew texts. Check revision history and compare with the cited printed edition.

title: Mechon Mamre
description: Hebrew biblical and rabbinic texts for reading and reference; consult the project’s edition notes.

title: Ben-Yehuda Project
description: Hebrew literary texts, including medieval poetry relevant to the guide’s historical scope.

title: Open Siddur
description: Liturgical texts, transcriptions and facsimiles with source and licensing information.

title: Bar-Ilan Responsa Project
description: Searchable rabbinic literature. Useful for locating passages; cite the underlying work and edition.

title: Ma’agarim
description: Historical Hebrew corpus and lexicographic research from the Academy of the Hebrew Language.

title: Talmud Yerushalmi critical edition
description: Digital critical-edition project for the Jerusalem Talmud; inspect tractate coverage and editorial method.

title: HebrewBooks
description: Scanned Hebrew books and journals; cite the scan’s printed title page, pagination and edition.

title: Otzar HaHochma
description: Large scanned-book database with search tools. Availability depends on subscription and collection.

title: Friedberg Genizah Project
description: Manuscript images, metadata and tools for Genizah research. Record shelfmarks and image permissions.

title: Hachi Garsinan
description: Textual witnesses and synopsis tools for Talmud Bavli research; distinguish manuscript from transcription.

title: Princeton Geniza Project
description: Documents, transcriptions and bibliographic connections for the Cairo Genizah. Record stable document identifiers.

title: Digital Mishnah
description: A digital edition project for comparing Mishnah textual witnesses. Consult project coverage and encoding documentation.

title: The Ilanot Project
description: Research on kabbalistic diagrams and diagrammatic manuscripts. Consult catalogue records and image rights.

title: DICTA
description: Hebrew text-analysis tools, including search, citation discovery and abbreviation expansion. Assess each tool against its corpus and task.

title: DICTA citation finder
description: Locate possible sources and quotations in Hebrew texts. Candidate matches need contextual verification.

title: eScriptorium
description: An open-source environment for transcription and handwritten-text recognition. Results depend on training data and require human correction.
access: Open-source software; hosting and setup required

title: Transkribus Hebrew-script models
description: A starting point for Hebrew-script handwritten-text recognition models. Test on representative pages before batch transcription.
access: Confirm current model and platform terms

title: RAMBI
description: Index of articles on Jewish studies. A catalogue record does not guarantee free full-text access.

title: Google Scholar
description: Search scholarly literature and citation trails. Check publication metadata against publisher or repository records.

title: Academia.edu
description: Author-shared research copies and profiles. Check version, publication details and lawful reuse; not a substitute for bibliographic verification.

title: Jewish Encyclopedia
description: Historical reference work useful as a starting point; its scholarship and terminology require comparison with current research.

title: Jastrow on Sefaria
description: A searchable entry point to Jastrow’s dictionary. Verify headwords, abbreviations and citations against the original edition when needed.

title: Tiresias
description: Ancient Mediterranean religions source database, useful for finding thematic parallels and references.
